name: Shoulder Stretch with Towel
description: Stretches the shoulder's internal rotators: a rolled towel held behind your back, top hand pulls up so the lower hand slides up your back.

source.title: Mayo Clinic: A guide to basic stretches

setup: Hold a rolled-up towel behind your back: right hand over your shoulder at the top, left hand behind your back at the bottom.
cues: Pull gently upward with the top hand.
You'll feel it in the shoulder of the lower arm.
Useful for tennis serves and overhead throwing.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Towel behind your back
keyframes.cue: Top hand behind your head, bottom hand behind your back.

keyframes.name: Pull up
keyframes.cue: Gently pull the towel upward with your top hand.
